info.title: modulus
info.description:
Command-line interface for the Cobytelabs Modulus framework.
      Scaffold modular-monolith applications, add modules, and generate CRUD code.

commands.description: Add a business module to an existing application

confirmations

options.description:
Show detailed output (child-process stdout, every written
file, etc.)

options.description: Suppress everything but errors and the final summary
